text:
The Panthers have played most of the season without Aleksander Barkov and Brad Marchand, and they are 13-8-3 anyway. Paul Maurice says both are "close" to returning (per Florida Hockey Now), which is the best news a team in a crowded Atlantic can get in November.

The lineup in the meantime has been built around the Tkachuk brothers. Sam Bennett, Matthew Tkachuk and Brady Tkachuk have played the most 5-on-5 minutes of any trio and taken 57% of the expected goals (the quality of chances), though they have only broken even on the scoreboard at 10-10. Bennett has 10 points in his last 10 and finished a hat trick in Saturday's 4-3 win in Buffalo. Matthew Tkachuk is riding a point streak NHL.com called impressive. Sandis Vilmanis, with 8 points in 10 against 3.8 expected, is running well ahead of his chances.

Florida plays the most special teams hockey around: about five penalties taken and five drawn a game. The power play makes it pay, at more than one expected goal a game. Overall the Panthers have 52% of the expected goals, and their goals for and against both sit close to what the chances predict.

Our playoff odds have Florida at 63%. What we'd watch: how Maurice fits Barkov and Marchand back into lines that have found something.
